scope: Continuous radius-two diagnostics with an explicitly constructed potential V=E+kappa Delta(psi)/psi and complex observables; not the Wilson potential. Finite positive matrix diagnostics retain original a_j,s_j, vacuum zero direction and both full source components. Full finite-character inverse and kinetic tensors retain all probabilities and n^-2. No sampled YM vacuum or assigned continuum response.
